tasks.subject: Task 4: The position_on definition DSL + board inheritance
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `position_on` declares a resource drag-orderable and expands to sort + default_sort + a hidden reposition action. Kanban boards inherit it.

**Naming:** `position_on` deliberately reuses kanban's verb rather than adding a third (`positioned_on` on the model, `position_on` in the definition layer).

**Board inheritance:** `dsl.rb:18` must stop seeding `Config.default` (nil = not declared); `Board#position_config_for(definition)` resolves LAZILY, mirroring `show_in_for` (board.rb:37). Lazy because `kanban` compiles the board eagerly at class-load (index_views.rb:121), so eager resolution would make declaration order matter. Update the 5 call sites in kanban_actions.rb (136, 259, 581, 733, 784).

**Check:** `rg -n "position_config\b" lib/plutonium/resource/controllers/kanban_actions.rb` → every hit must be `position_config_for(current_definition)`.

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 rake test`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/plutonium/definition/positioning.rb", "lib/plutonium/definition/base.rb", "lib/plutonium/kanban/dsl.rb", "lib/plutonium/kanban/board.rb", "lib/plutonium/resource/controllers/kanban_actions.rb", "test/plutonium/definition/positioning_test.rb"], "verifyCommand": "bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 rake test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["four DSL forms", "Mode A boot check", "Mode B skips check", "expansion correct", "Mode C inert", "board inherits definition", "board block overrides", "lazy resolution"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

**Verify:** `bundle exec appraisal rails-8.1 ruby -Itest test/plutonium/resource/controllers/position_actions_test.rb`

